name: scifact
description: SciFact (Wadden et al., 2020) in BEIR format: 5,183 scientific abstracts and expert-written claims with relevance judgements. BEIR's train qrels (809 queries) are used as the dev split for any tuning; the 300 test queries are held out and are the only ones reported.
